budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Cemetery Commission warrant article for the FY25 Annual Town Meeting, stated as $10K, was approved 2 to 0.
budget_items.quote: b. cemetery commission warrant article for fy25 annual town meeting article ($10k) - motion passed 2 to 0.

budget_items.topic: North Cemetery back field and lot estimate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair and Vice-Chair say the Commission decided on a lot estimate of about 40 that proved not to be true, and that opening the back field this year would have cost the Town; deferring it would save $50,000.00 this year.
budget_items.quote: saving that $50,000.00 for this year, may certainly help the town in their budget going forward.

budget_items.topic: Possible gift for a wall project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission is grateful for a possible gift of $175K for a wall; the minutes say it is in the research stage.
budget_items.quote: the possibility of a generous gift of $175k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair states the Commission controls the Perpetual Care Account funds and may spend only the interest; no dollar amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: we are not allowed to spend the principle, only the interest generated.

budget_items.topic: Perpetual care funds used for bench
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter alleges perpetual care money paid for engraving a bench and its foundation; no amount is printed and the minutes record it as an allegation.
budget_items.quote: your commission used money from the perpetual care funds for engraving a bench and provide a foundation for the bench;

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW Director says DPW has been paying for Ramaker and will continue to; the Chair says the Commission has paid since 2010. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the dpw has been paying for ramaker by his records a few years, and going forward he is going to be paying for it.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A refund on a grave and burial plot fee was issued, reportedly on 7 and 21 November 2023, without notice to the Commission; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: a refund was given on a grave and burial plot fee?
